Mitigation: Cleanse to DQ rules; dress rehearsals; data owners sign off

Risk: Employee data processed in a region not allowed
Mitigation: Region map per partner; transfer assessments; monitoring

Risk: Works councils object to monitoring or AI use
Mitigation: Early consultation; advisory-only AI; processing register

Risk: Payroll or benefits errors at go-live
Mitigation: Parallel run; reconciliation; hypercare with payroll

Risk: Partner API changes break an integration
Mitigation: Contract tests; versioning; partner notice clauses

Risk: A key partner fails or exits
Mitigation: Exit plan; second-source option; data return in contract

Risk: Positions are not maintained after go-live
Mitigation: Position workflow; KPI K-20; approval rules

Risk: Scope creep beyond the pilot slice
Mitigation: Gate reviews; wave plan; change control
